title: Second moment of a single row of a Rademacher projection
statement:
Fix integers $k > 0$ and $d \ge 0$, a vector $x \in \bbr^d$, and a row index $i \in \{1, \dots, k\}$. Draw $\omega$ from the joint Rademacher measure on $\mathrm{Rad\Omega}(k,d)$, form the Rademacher matrix $A(\omega) \in \bbr^{k \times d}$, and let $(A(\omega)x)_i$ denote the $i$-th coordinate of the image of $x$ under the linear map $A(\omega)$. Then the second moment of this coordinate is
\[
  \E\bigl[\,(A(\omega)x)_i^2\,\bigr] = \frac{\norm{x}^2}{k}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: i a row index in Fin k
expectation taken over the joint Rademacher product measure
